query: I was just walking my golden retriever puppy earlier, he kept stopping to sniff every dandelion on the sidewalk and even tried to carry a half-eaten popsicle stick home, I had to wrestle it out of his mouth so he wouldn’t get sick. Then I stopped by the little boba shop on the corner, their taro milk tea with 50% sugar and extra pearls was way sweeter than usual today, I think the new barista might have messed up the recipe. When I got home I tried to stream my favorite show on my phone but it wouldn’t load, I think my network connection is acting really bad, the VPN I use keeps cutting out too, I checked and mobile data is turned off right now and data saver mode is switched on, can you help me fix this so I can use my mobile internet properly?
